commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+3' Cesar Azpilicueta (Atl. Madrid) trips an opposition player and Guillermo Cuadra signals a foul.
90+1' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
90' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) works the corner short.
87' Miguel Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.
87' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) is given a yellow card.
86' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) takes a short corner kick.
85' Carlos Dotor (Celta Vigo) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar.
84' Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
84' The Celta Vigo players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
81' Rafael Benitez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Carlos Dotor (Celta Vigo) replacing Luca de la Torre.
81' Substitution. Jorgen Strand Larsen makes way for Miguel Rodriguez (Celta Vigo).
80' Caglar Soyuncu (Atl. Madrid) has a goal ruled out for offside!
80' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
80' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The ball is out of play and Atl. Madrid manage to earn a corner.
79' 3:6 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
76' The corner is flicked onto Unai Nunez (Celta Vigo), but his close-range header flies a whisker wide of the left post.
76' Now Celta Vigo have a corner.
76' The substitution has been made. Caglar Soyuncu (Atl. Madrid) has replaced Antoine Griezmann.
74' The resulting corner from Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) is cleared.
74' The attendance is 20282.
74' A quickly taken corner by Atl. Madrid.
72' Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
70' Goal - 0:3! Nahuel Molina laid the ball off to Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid), who shot from close range low into the back of the net, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
69' Luca de la Torre (Celta Vigo) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the right side of the goal, but Jan Oblak was alert and made a comfortable save.
69' The corner is swung in but Celta Vigo can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
68' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
67' Koke (Atl. Madrid) smashes the ball upfield and Antoine Griezmann controls it with a great first touch.
64' 0 - 2 Goal! Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot inside the right post. He makes it 0:2.
63' Atl. Madrid keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Fran Beltran leaves the pitch and Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) comes on.
61' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) comes onto the pitch so that Iago Aspas can be given a rest.
57' Diego Simeone decides to make a substitution. Marcos Llorente will be replaced by Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid).
57' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Saul Niguez walks off the pitch to be replaced by Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid).
56' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) latches on to a sweet pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a brilliant shot towards the goal, but he hits the crossbar!
54' Saul Niguez (Atl. Madrid) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.

53' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
51' Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.

49' A terrific piece of skill by Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) inside the box gives him a clear goal scoring opportunity, but his shot is blocked right on the line by a defender after the keeper was beaten.
46' Diego Simeone has made a change at the break. Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) has come on in place of Marcos Llorente.
46' Half-time substitution. Samuel Lino will not participate anymore and Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) is coming on.
46' The whistle blows and Guillermo Cuadra starts the second half.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+4' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) offside.
45+3' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) misses a big opportunity to score after striking the ball wide of the right post.

45+2' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the right side of the goal. However, Agustin Marchesin anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
44' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.

43' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the right post is, however, superbly saved by Agustin Marchesin!
43' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) is able to continue to play.
42' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
42' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
40' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
35' Luca de la Torre races towards the box before laying off to Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo), who picks it up but drags a shot well wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
33' Close! A mistake by a defender gifts Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) a chance inside the box, but his efforts curls just around the right post.
30' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
29' 0 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Vicente Guaita no chance!
28' The manager makes a subsitution with Vicente Guaita (Celta Vigo) coming on for Kevin Vazquez.
27' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
25' We have witnessed a red card for Ivan Villar (Celta Vigo).

25' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Ivan Villar (Celta Vigo). Guillermo Cuadra saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. PENALTY to Atl. Madrid! Let's see who will take responsibility.
25' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
23' Mario Hermoso (Atl. Madrid) displays his superb passing ability after picking out Cesar Azpilicueta with a fine lofted pass to continue their attacking move.
21' Atl. Madrid are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
17' Kevin Vazquez (Celta Vigo) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
14' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
13' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Ivan Villar has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
13' Some great controlled play and passing from Celta Vigo. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
11' The resulting corner from Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) is cleared by the defence.

9' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) can't believe his eyes as he blows an opportunity from close range. It looked really simple and he only needed to tap the ball in, but he failed. The ball goes well wide of the right post. Hang your head in shame son.
8' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) takes a direct free kick.
7' A perfect long pass by Axel Witsel (Atl. Madrid) finds Samuel Lino. He latches on to the pass and continues his attacking run.
6' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) beats several players before unleashing a long-range shot on goal that flies miles wide of the left post.

4' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the right side of the net, but Jan Oblak leaps like a salmon to deny him.
3' A raking crossfield pass from Cesar Azpilicueta (Atl. Madrid) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
